text: [Image #1][Image #2] still not working. check it out
resolution: Fixed the remaining visible wall-corner strip shown in the latest screenshots. The root cause was that trimmed wall boxes still rendered their cut end caps, so even after triangular miters the renderer showed a vertical crossing strip. Wall boxes trimmed for L/T joins now carry openRunMin/openRunMax flags, the editor renderer uses open-ended box geometries for those joined ends, and the compiled world stream/world_loader has matching open-box shape IDs and geometry batches. Also removed the internal trim face from the triangular miter prisms. Added focused wallSlabs coverage asserting painted L-corner colors, miter halves, and omitted cut caps. Verified wallSlabs 2/2, compile/world-parity 15/15, build-placed 57/57, build-snap 29/29, ReleaseFast world_loader build, and SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship hmsc-int.
